title: Where required.
officialText:
Smoke and heat vents shall be installed in the roofs of buildings or portions thereof occupied for the uses
set forth in Sections 910.2.1 and 910.2.2. Vents shall be installed at the top of a closed shaft in accordance with Section 708.12.1.
